note: Rewritten from the English translation cited in Chhotani (1997), the author not having examined specimens; alates are recorded as unknown in the original and only soldiers and workers are described; the measurements are scattered through the original abstract, four being entered here, body length, head length, head width and pronotal width; the remaining measurements, synonymy lists and literature citations are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, mandibles brown, body white. Head sparsely covered with erect setae; abdominal tergites weakly hairy, with long setae posteriorly. Head in dorsal view nearly square, slightly longer than wide; frontal prominence in dorsal view broadly conical, its sides slightly uneven, in lateral view straight above and arcuate below. Fontanelle at the base of the inner margin of the frontal prominence, transverse, large. Postclypeus short. Labrum moderately wide, lateral margins rounded, bilobed, anterior angles acute. Mandibles rod-like, almost as long as the head. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 2 and 3 about equal in length, segment 4 slightly shorter. Anterior margin of pronotum slightly concave. Body length 3.3–3.5 mm, head length with mandibles 2.47 mm, head width 1.06 mm, pronotal width 0.57 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head yellowish white, body white, the dark gut showing through. Head and abdominal tergites sparsely hairy. Head nearly pentagonal and slightly rounded; head suture and fontanelle very indistinct. Postclypeus about half as long as wide, rather strongly inflated. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 equal to segments 3 and 4 together, segment 3 equal to segment 4. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin not concave. Body length 3.5–3.8 mm, head width 0.87 mm, pronotal width 0.53 mm.
